head_commit.message:
Bind preserved preflight snapshots at their actual archival boundary [qualify-interface-v43]

The original RED descriptor/test commit pins pre-fix source hashes but did not include the two production root files. Archive the captured exact original bytes, retain the local pre-native freeze refusal, and correct the qualifier lookup without changing any frozen test, result or runtime algorithm.

run.name: UDM V43 independently replayed native experiment interface

archive_policy: Stream regular bytes to SHA256 cache; inventory links, never follow or extract them.

available_costs.child_and_inherited_counters: Retained separately; not silently summed as disjoint full lifecycle cost.
available_costs.scope: Actual V43 builder pip-wheel attempts and original native-controller launches; builder Git logs and total qualification wall retained. Fixture-oracle subprocesses and identity checks are not included in these counters. Child counters separate; engineering/model/tool/storage lifecycle costs UNKNOWN.

build_accounting.boundary: Local measured commands/counters, not signed historical timing or complete engineering/model/tool cost.

complete_lifecycle_cost: UNKNOWN; engineering/model/tool costs and some setup commands are outside native/build counters

manifest.boundary: Original links retained without dereference; inspect members safely without automatic extraction.

native.boundary: All retained native packet outcomes reconstructed; exact candidate/import context additionally checked for the explicit native-context supplement.

native_handoff.boundary: Fixed source-frozen handoff diagnostic; actual packet and CAS lineage independently checked. Preflight no-launch assertions are frozen executed control statements, not external signed action-monitor attestations.
